key.name: toggle-tiling
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to enable or disable automatic tiling for the current workspace.

key.name: tile-all-horizontal
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to tile all windows on the current monitor horizontally.

key.name: tile-focused-horizontal
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to tile the focused window to its horizontal position.

key.name: reset-windows
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to reset all windows to their default size and position.

key.name: focus-left
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to move focus to the window on the left.

key.name: focus-right
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to move focus to the window on the right.

key.name: swap-left
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to swap the focused window with the window to its left.

key.name: swap-right
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to swap the focused window with the window to its right.
